route.CKYCR.name: Use your existing KYC record (CKYC)
route.CKYCR.summary: If you have a KYC Identifier, the bank can download your KYC record with your consent.
route.VIDEO_KYC.name: Video KYC from home
route.VIDEO_KYC.summary: A trained bank official verifies you on a live video call.
route.AADHAAR_FACE_AUTH.name: Aadhaar Face Authentication
route.AADHAAR_FACE_AUTH.summary: A bank official or banking agent verifies your Aadhaar using your face instead of fingerprints.
route.DIGITAL_KYC.name: In-person Digital KYC
route.DIGITAL_KYC.summary: A bank official photographs you and your original document, at the branch or at your home.
route.FINGERPRINT_EKYC.name: Aadhaar fingerprint e-KYC
route.FINGERPRINT_EKYC.summary: A bank official or banking agent verifies your Aadhaar with a fingerprint scan.
route.AADHAAR_OTP_EKYC.name: Aadhaar OTP e-KYC (limited account)
route.AADHAAR_OTP_EKYC.summary: Open an account online with an OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile. Limits apply until full KYC.
route.SMALL_ACCOUNT.name: Small Account
route.SMALL_ACCOUNT.summary: An account you can open with a photograph and your signature or thumb impression, with limits.
route.SUBSIDY_EXCEPTION.name: Exception route for government benefits
route.SUBSIDY_EXCEPTION.summary: If you need the account for a government benefit and e-KYC fails because of age, illness or injury, a bank official can verify you another way.
why.from_home: You can do this from home.
why.official_can_visit: You can ask the bank to send an official to your home.
why.no_gestures: You will not be asked to blink, smile or make any facial movement.
why.face_instead: Uses your face instead of your fingerprints.
why.otp_signature: On the digital form, an OTP counts as your signature. It can come to your mobile or a family member's. You still sign or give a thumb impression on the printed form.
why.thumb_ink: You can give an ink thumb impression instead of a signature; worn fingerprints don't matter for this.
why.fastest_ckyc: Fastest, because your KYC is already on record.
why.full_kyc: Gives you a full KYC with no account limits.
not.needs_pan: Needs a PAN card or e-PAN. Without PAN, choose a route where you can give Form 60.
not.needs_identity_source: Needs Aadhaar (OTP or offline verification) or a KYC Identifier.
not.needs_aadhaar: Needs you to share your Aadhaar. Sharing Aadhaar is your choice; it is not mandatory for KYC.
not.needs_linked_mobile: Needs a mobile number linked to your Aadhaar.
not.fingerprints: Not suitable, because your fingerprints may not scan. The other routes need no fingerprint.
not.needs_ovd: Needs an original identity document such as Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence, NREGA job card or NPR letter.
not.needs_aadhaar_benefit: Needs your Aadhaar number. To receive a government benefit or subsidy, you have to give your Aadhaar number to the bank.
caution.aadhaar_for_benefit: Because you want a government benefit or subsidy, the bank must ask for your Aadhaar number. For other accounts, Aadhaar is your choice.
not.only_subsidy: Only for people opening an account to receive a government benefit or subsidy.
caution.face_auth_alternatives: If face authentication does not succeed, the other routes here remain open to you.
caution.no_prompting: During the video call, Sahay will only read out the official's questions. It cannot help you answer, because the bank must stop the process if anyone prompts you.
caution.aadhaar_fresh: If the bank uses an offline Aadhaar file or QR code, it must be at most 3 working days old on the day of the video call.
caution.epan_printout: Show your PAN card, or your e-PAN on a screen. A printout of an e-PAN is not accepted in video KYC.
caution.redact_aadhaar: Your Aadhaar number is hidden in everything Sahay shares with the bank.
accom.deaf: Tell the official at the start that you are deaf or hard of hearing; captions and a sign-language interpreter can be arranged.
accom.blind: Before the call, Sahay guides you by voice to photograph your documents.
accom.bc_assist: A banking agent (Business Correspondent) can sit with you and help during the process.
accom.officer_review: If any step does not work for you, Sahay sends your case to a bank officer. The bank cannot reject you without reviewing it and recording a reason.
limits.otp: Limits: balance up to ₹1 lakh, total credits up to ₹2 lakh a year, and full KYC within one year.
limits.small: Limits: credits up to ₹1 lakh a year, withdrawals and transfers up to ₹10,000 a month, balance up to ₹50,000. Valid for 12 months, extendable by 12 more if you have applied for an ID document.
cap.no_document: I can't see a card yet. Hold it flat, about 30 centimetres in front of the camera, against a plain background if you can.
cap.too_close: Too close. Move the phone a little further away.
cap.move_closer: The card is too far away. Bring it a little closer to the camera.
cap.move_left: The left side is cut off. Move the phone a little to your left.
cap.move_right: The right side is cut off. Move the phone a little to your right.
cap.move_up: The top is cut off. Move the phone up a little.
cap.move_down: The bottom is cut off. Move the phone down a little.
cap.card_right: Part of the card is outside the picture. Move the card a little to your right.
cap.card_left: Part of the card is outside the picture. Move the card a little to your left.
cap.card_down: The top of the card is cut off. Move the card down a little.
cap.card_up: The bottom of the card is cut off. Move the card up a little.
cap.card_too_close: Too close. Hold the card a little further from the camera.
cap.too_dark: It's too dark. Move to a brighter place or turn on a light.
cap.glare: There's a shine on the card. Tilt it slightly away from the light.
cap.blurry: The picture is blurry. Hold the phone still for a moment.
cap.printout_epan: This looks like a printout of an e-PAN. For video KYC, show the PAN card or the e-PAN on a screen.
cap.wrong_document: This looks like your {found}. Please show your {expected}.
cap.aadhaar_download_date: This Aadhaar copy was downloaded on {date}. If the bank verifies its QR code for video KYC, it must be at most 3 working days old, so a fresh download may be needed.
consent.assist: Sahay will use your camera and microphone to guide you. Pictures are checked and then discarded; Sahay does not keep them. Details read from your documents are shared only with the bank, with your Aadhaar number hidden. Do you agree?
consent.record_needs: Would you like the bank to record the kind of support you need, so it can help you better? This is optional.
consent.referral: May Sahay send your details, and the step that did not work, to a bank officer for review?
relay.joined: You are now in the video call. I will read out the official's questions.
relay.refuse: I can't help with answers during the video call. Please answer the official yourself; you can ask them to repeat or explain the question.
relay.untranslated: (Translation unavailable; showing the official's original words.)
ask.unavailable: I can't answer questions right now. You can ask a bank officer to review your case.

scam.verdict.LIKELY_SCAM: This looks like a scam. Do not reply, click or share anything.
scam.verdict.SUSPICIOUS: Be careful. This message has warning signs.
scam.verdict.NO_SIGNS: I found no common warning signs, but that does not prove it is genuine.
scam.sig.ASKS_SECRET: It asks for an OTP, PIN or password. A real bank never asks for these.
scam.sig.ASKS_DOCUMENTS: It asks you to send your Aadhaar, PAN or photo. Don't send KYC documents to unknown people.
scam.sig.REMOTE_ACCESS_APP: It asks you to install an app or share your screen. That can let someone control your phone.
scam.sig.LINK: It has a link. Don't open links sent by message.
scam.sig.INSTALL_APP: It asks you to download or install something. Only use your bank's official app.
scam.sig.URGENCY_THREAT: It rushes or threatens you, for example that your account will be blocked. Fraudsters do this.
scam.sig.KYC_PRETEXT: It is about updating your KYC. Fraudsters often use KYC as an excuse.
scam.advice.verify: Before doing anything, call your bank on the number from its official website, or visit your branch.
scam.advice.never_share: Never share your OTP, PIN, password or card details with anyone.
scam.advice.report: If you have already shared details or lost money, call 1930 now, or report at cybercrime.gov.in, and tell your bank.
scam.in_call: You are on the video call with the bank. Finish the call first; you can check messages afterwards.
ui.scam_open: Got a KYC call or message? Check if it's a scam
